title: com.docker.sandbox/ssh-agent@1
description: Config schema for one ssh-agent need: the phase whose processes can reach the SSH agent the runtime exposes on the user's behalf, with credential@1's phase boundary, and what the agent may sign. An entry stating neither sign nor authenticate is unbounded: the agent signs whatever the sandbox asks. An entry stating either signs only what it names. Which backing agent answers is the runtime's decision; the Kit names no agent, socket, or key. Instance-shaped, keyed by phase. The @1 in the type names this schema; it moves when the schema does.

sign.description: Namespaces of the namespaced (SSHSIG) signatures the agent may make: git for commits and tags, file for files. Omit for none in a bounded entry; an empty list is an error.

authenticate.description: Servers the agent may log in to, as host or user@host: a literal lowercase DNS name with no wildcard, port, or IP address. A login is signed only for a session the client bound to one of these servers' host keys. Omit for no logins in a bounded entry; an empty list is an error.
